notes: Libretto by Emanuel Schikaneder (1791). Words as printed in the Edition Peters vocal score, which the app follows where it differs from the libretto: "kommt ihr glücklich wieder fort" (the libretto has "kommt ihr wieder glücklich fort"), "im Tempel", Papageno's "Ich möchte gerne wohl....", the capital in "Beide", the apostrophes in "nah'", "hör'", "sag'", "Höll'", "wär'", "denk'" and "Schand'", and the repeats of the music (Papageno's "wär' der Teufel" four times, "und immer still" three times). The Third Lady sings only "Die Königin," where the other two sing "Ganz nah' ist euch die Königin," (bars 33-34). The chorus offstage (tenors and basses: "Entweiht ist die heilige Schwelle, hinab mit den Weibern zur Hölle!") is heard with the piano and has no phrases here. IPA follows sung German stage diction: final -er, -ern as [ɐ]; the prefixes er-, ver-, zer- with [ɛr]; r elsewhere rolled or flipped; ch as [ç] after front vowels and [x] after back vowels; glottal stops [ʔ] before initial vowels; final b d g devoiced.
